## Review

### Findings

#### Medium

- **[breaking-change-service-mapping]** `ogr/services/pagure/service.py:28` — The @use_for_service decorators for src.fedoraproject.org have been moved from PagureService to ForgejoService. Downstream consumers calling get_service_class() with these URLs will receive ForgejoService instead of PagureService. This is a backward-incompatible API surface change.

#### Low

- **[test-data-inconsistency]** `tests/integration/factory/test_factory.py:51` — The integration test creates PagureService with src.fedoraproject.org to match pre-migration recorded cassette data. Will need updating when re-recorded post-migration.

---
**Labels:** PR modifies Forgejo and Pagure service mappings for dist-git domain migration
